title: The Small Orchard
author: Odile Eastwick
blurb: Lena Vane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
